This page is the data manifest for the hEART 2026 poster. Download the source files from the providers below and place them at the exact paths shown. The `input/` directory is intentionally excluded from version control because some sources are large or access-controlled.

## National Travel Survey, 2002-2024

Travel survey data from England. The scripts use home-to-work trips from 2002-2019, before COVID-19 disruption.

- Used by: `R/nts_histogram.R`, `R/nts_calibration.R`
- Provider: [UK Data Service study 5340](https://datacatalogue.ukdataservice.ac.uk/studies/study/5340)
- Required local file: `input/raw/UKDA-5340-tab/tab/trip_eul_2002-2024.tab`
- Download format: TAB extraction


## 2011 Census Output Area boundaries

England and Wales Output Area boundaries used to construct Leeds centroids and map accessibility.

- Used by: `R/nts_calibration.R`
- Provider: [UK Open Geography portal](https://geoportal.statistics.gov.uk/datasets/8df53342abe043ab89534214206617ae_0/)
- Required local file: `input/raw/Output_Areas_Dec_2011_Boundaries_EW_BGC_2022_-4410048714460462685.gpkg`
- Download format: GeoPackage


## Leeds and UK local-authority boundaries

The calibration script also requires the May 2025 local-authority boundary file in order to extract Leeds.

- Used by: `R/nts_calibration.R`
- Required local file: `input/raw/LAD_MAY_2025_UK_BFC_V2_6634550694215771101.gpkg`
- Source: [UK Open Geography portal](https://geoportal.statistics.gov.uk/)


## WP101EW workplace population

Workplace population counts for Yorkshire and the Humber census output areas.

- Used by: `R/nts_calibration.R`
- Provider: [Nomis, Census 2011 WP101EW](https://www.nomisweb.co.uk/census/2011/wp101ew)
- Required local file: `input/raw/workplace_population_yorkshire_humber.csv`
- Download format: CSV


## Ordnance Survey Multimodal Routing Network

Network links, nodes, turn restrictions, and average car speeds used to calculate travel times between Leeds Output Area centroids.

- Used by: `R/nts_calibration.R` through the `losdos` package
- Required local file: `input/raw/osmrn.gpkg`
- Access: UK-based researchers can obtain it through [EDINA Digimap](https://digimap.edina.ac.uk/); commercial access is available from [Ordnance Survey](https://www.ordnancesurvey.co.uk/products/os-multi-modal-routing-network)
- Download format: GeoPackage

## Local data checklist

Before running `R/nts_calibration.R`, confirm that these five files exist:

```text
input/raw/UKDA-5340-tab/tab/trip_eul_2002-2024.tab
input/raw/Output_Areas_Dec_2011_Boundaries_EW_BGC_2022_-4410048714460462685.gpkg
input/raw/LAD_MAY_2025_UK_BFC_V2_6634550694215771101.gpkg
input/raw/workplace_population_yorkshire_humber.csv
input/raw/osmrn.gpkg
```

File names are part of the current script interface. If a provider supplies a differently named export, rename or update the corresponding script path before running it.
